sources.fullCitation: Bernard Etté und sein Orchester, refrain by Kurt Mühlhardt. “Blaue Jungs von der Marine.” Marschlied from Korvettenkapitän; label credit “Dr. Kaper / Rotter / Robinson”. Kristall, order no. 3098, n.d. YouTube transfer by Wunschkonzert.
sources.title: Blaue Jungs von der Marine — Kristall 3098

sources.researchNote: The label image accompanying the upload reads “Best.-Nr. 3098”, not “78 N”, and names Bernard Etté und sein Orchester and refrain singer Kurt Mühlhardt. SRC0758 shows the other title on the same catalogue issue, also numbered 3098; this does not establish that the transfers came from the same physical copy. “Aufnahme 1930” is the uploader’s recording-year statement, not an independently established issue date. SRC0471 documents the composition’s copyright registration, not the disc or its publisher; the record label does not name Alrobi.

sources.fullCitation: George Nettelmann und sein Orchester, refrain sung by Walter Jurmann. “Ich frag’, Madame, wann kommen wir zusamm’?” Foxtrot; label credits Bronislaw Kaper, Walter Jurmann and Fritz Rotter. Kristall 3229, recorded Berlin, 15 September 1931. Shellac disc, Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv; filmed-label transfer on YouTube. Session data from the title list at musiktiteldb.de.
sources.title: Ich frag’, Madame, wann kommen wir zusamm’? — Kristall 3229
sources.creator: George Nettelmann und sein Orchester, Refrain: Walter Jurmann
sources.researchNote: The filmed label confirms the title and authorship credit. The uploader supplies the Berlin and film context; the catalogue number and session date are independently supplied by musiktiteldb.de. Its title-list entry dates the Berlin recording to 15 September 1931 and leaves the release-date column empty. The structured date identifies that session, not the commercial issue of Kristall 3229. The examined label does not name Edition Karl Brüll; the publisher credit rests on a separate printed source.
